description: GM Cycle Routes is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for Greater Manchester. Cycle routes in Greater Manchester, including on-road, off-road, and canal towpaths and National Cycle Network routes. Data provided by the GM local authorities. The dataset is available in MapInfo.tab, Google.kmz, and ESRI.shp file formats. Coverage: Transport for Greater Manchester. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Greater Manchester. It offers 9 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
